requirements: Name the reusable failure class or capability gap before importing a method.
Pin the exact source revision and verify its licence before copying or adapting material.
Reduce the source to the smallest coherent method that fits Design Studio's progressive-disclosure architecture.
Record what changed from the source and retain required attribution.
Protect the adopted behaviour with an eval, contract test or dogfood comparison.
Reject the candidate when it adds prompt volume or maintenance cost without improving outcomes or reducing human correction.
